title: My dream trip to Banff & Lake Louise
place: Banff, Lake Louise and Moraine Lake
excerpt: Mountains, turquoise lakes, scenic drives, and unforgettable views in the Canadian Rockies.
body:
Visiting Banff and Lake Louise was a dream come true. The mountains, clear water, scenic roads, and peaceful viewpoints made every part of the trip memorable.

This album brings together some of my favourite moments from Alberta, including practical lessons from planning the route, parking, and visiting the lakes.
